Alaska: what's on the November 3, 2026 ballot

Every candidate below is listed alphabetically, with party shown as text only. Open a name for their stated positions, background and recent news, each with sources.

Open Alaska on the map

Key dates

  • Voter registration deadline: October 4, 2026. Registrations must be received or postmarked 30 days before Election Day. You can register online at voterregistration.alaska.gov.
  • Early and absentee in-person voting: October 19, 2026 to November 2, 2026. Early and absentee in-person voting sites open 15 days before the election, and absentee in-person voting continues on Election Day. Hours depend on the location.
  • Deadline to apply for a ballot by mail: October 24, 2026. Your application must be received by October 24. You can apply for a ballot by fax or online delivery from October 19 until 5:00 p.m. Alaska time on November 2. Ballots returned by mail must be postmarked by Election Day.
  • Election Day: November 3, 2026. Polls are open 7:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. local time. The general election uses ranked-choice voting.

Official election information: Alaska Division of Elections

Who's running

Only the U.S. Senate and governor races are loaded so far. Other statewide offices, ballot measures, U.S. House and local races aren't loaded yet. Check your sample ballot for the full list.

Federal

United States Senator

Voters elect one U.S. senator to a six-year term by ranked-choice voting. Incumbent Dan S. Sullivan is running for re-election.

Two candidates are named Dan Sullivan. The incumbent is Dan S. Sullivan; Daniel J. Sullivan Jr. is a different person.

State

Governor / Lieutenant Governor

Voters elect a governor and lieutenant governor together as a ticket for a four-year term by ranked-choice voting. This is an open seat because Gov. Mike Dunleavy is term-limited. Running mates: Dave Bronson with Josh Church; Jonathan S. "JKT" Kreiss-Tomkins with Zac Johnson; Treg Taylor with Candi English; Bernadette M. Wilson with Michael K. Shower.

  • Dave Bronson Registered Republican · Open seat

  • Treg Taylor Registered Republican · Open seat
  • Bernadette M. Wilson Registered Republican · Open seat
